Visually reviewed the existing customer-card and Page Inspection screenshots.
Classified which customer-card observations support handbook/training draft.
Classified which setup gaps block O2C, customer write readiness and posting readiness.

actionsNotTaken: No customer created, edited, saved or deleted.

acceptedCheckpoints: Customer card visual context with U-CUST-100 / Universaarl Kunde 100.
Visible General and Address/Contact field areas.
Visible required/warning markers on Fakturierung and Zahlungen.
Page Inspection boundary with Customer Card (21, Card) and Customer (18).
missingCheckpointsForNextRun: Visible values for Customer Posting Group, VAT Business Posting Group and Payment Terms Code where exposed on the card.
Page Inspection after the relevant FastTabs are visible.
End screenshot proving no save/edit/draft/post action occurred.
screenshotQa.learning: A BC UI decision needs separate screenshots for list, card, expanded FastTabs and Page Inspection. End-state screenshots alone are too weak for setup-gap conclusions.

handbookTrainingUsableNow: A Debitorenkarte shows the customer number and customer name as identity fields.
The General area contains balances, credit limit and blocked status, which are useful for explaining daily customer-card orientation.
The Address and Contact area is visible and mostly empty for U-CUST-100, so it can be used to explain data-quality gaps.
The FactBox shows customer history and totals, which is useful for beginner orientation.
Page Inspection confirms the BC object context Customer Card (21) and table Customer (18).
setupGapsBlockingO2C: Fakturierung is marked with a required/warning indicator but was not expanded in the accepted evidence.
Zahlungen is marked with a required/warning indicator but was not expanded in the accepted evidence.
Customer Posting Group, VAT Business Posting Group, Gen. Business Posting Group, Payment Terms Code and Payment Method Code were not proven complete on the card.
Address, country/region, city, postal code, phone, e-mail and contact are empty or not validated.
No customer template correctness, number-series behavior, default dimensions or sales document suitability was proven.

decision.reason: U-CUST-100 is useful as observed customer-card teaching material, but the visible required markers on Fakturierung and Zahlungen are exactly the setup gaps a BC consultant must resolve before claiming O2C readiness.

proved: PWS-MD-004B evidence is sufficient for a beginner-oriented handbook/training draft about finding and reading an existing Debitorenkarte.
PWS-MD-004B evidence is not sufficient for customer write readiness, O2C readiness, VAT correctness, posting group correctness, Preview Posting or Posting.
The next live work should inspect the missing billing/payment setup areas, not repeat customer creation or jump to sales documents.
notProved: No customer setup values were proven complete.
No O2C document route is approved.
No posting group correctness is proven.
No posted entries, Preview Posting, sales invoice, payment or ledger trace exist from this customer decision.
warnings: Do not use U-CUST-100 as proof that customer master data is setup-ready.
Do not proceed to sales order, sales invoice, Preview Posting or Posting before the billing/payment FastTabs and dependent setup are read-first proven or deliberately parked.
Future UI runs need more screenshot checkpoints around expanded FastTabs and Page Inspection.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: PWS-MD-004B proved U-CUST-100 exists and can be viewed on the Debitorenkarte with Customer Card (21) / Customer (18), no write.
nextStepDecision.reason: The local decision was needed to prevent duplicate customer creation and premature O2C claims.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: It directly addresses the visible required/warning markers on Fakturierung and Zahlungen with stronger screenshot QA.
Vendor write work should wait until the customer setup-gap pattern and payment boundary are clearer.
Item/service write work depends on UOM, posting, VAT product, inventory and costing setup.
O2C remains blocked until customer billing/payment fields and related posting/VAT setup are consciously handled.
A short training card can be drafted after or alongside the FastTab proof, but it should not replace the setup-gap read-first evidence.

queueChangesMade: Selected PWS-MD-004C as the next targeted read-first case.
Kept O2C, vendor write and item write gates parked.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It is the smallest useful live proof: read-only, no save, and focused on the exact customer-card FastTabs that currently block setup/O2C claims.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not click Edit/New or save the customer.
Do not change posting groups, payment terms, VAT or dimensions.
Do not treat visible field names as correctness proof.
Capture multiple screenshots before drawing conclusions.
requiredPreparation: Capture list context, card context, expanded Fakturierung, expanded Zahlungen, Page Inspection and no-save end context.
